rule-content-11: During the event period, after successfully sign up, users who complete any futures trade (must be fully closed) and meet the following conditions will receive a lottery chance:
rule-content-12: Holding time of at least 60 minutes
rule-content-13: The order must generate a total trading fee of no less than 1 USDT and have a position value of no less than 1,000 USDT
rule-content-14: If you did not receive a drawing entry, it means your order did not meet the eligibility requirements.
rule-content-21: BTC, ETH, SOL, Profit Boost Cards (1%–20%), PEPE, SHIB, DOGE, and more prizes will be added soon.
rule-content-31: If your futures order meets the lottery conditions and has a profit rate greater than 100%, you will get one chance to draw a “Profit Boost Card.”
rule-content-32: There are 20 levels of Profit Boost Cards, offering from 1% up to 20% bonus.
rule-content-33: The system will calculate your USDT reward based on your obtained boost rate × your order’s profit amount, and automatically distribute it to your Funding Account. The reward can be freely used or directly withdrawn.
rule-content-41: Each lottery chance is valid for 7 days after it is obtained. Please complete your draw as soon as possible.
rule-content-51: Eligible closed orders will be converted into lottery chances within 1 hour and displayed in your lottery list.
